note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (38 mm case, spec sheet); heights are the SNKL41K1 values (same family, no orthographic side view). All steel: polished case, bezel, shoulders, indices, hands, crown and bracelet centre, brushed mid and outer links. SEIKO, the 5 shield, the print, the minute track, the index pips, the green gasket and SUN 5 stay in the dial map.

case.note: bezel 17.95 mm (inner line at 9 o'clock in the photo) on a 19 mm case middle that stays below the end link and shoulders

dial.note: flat to the minute track, then the green gasket ring slopes up to the crystal, both from the photo

lug.note: square shoulders: outline from the silhouette; tip_y = top of the shoulders and of the outer end-link pieces

end_link.note: per bracelet column: the centre and mid pieces run 2.5 mm past the lug tips (trace: 23.5 mm vs 20.7 mm)

bracelet.columns_note: [x0, x1 as a fraction of the half width, row phase in pitches, material]: polished centre and brushed mid pieces in step, joints 2.5 mm past the outer joints (photo); brushed outer links
bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl (house, from SUR419P1): 7 mm radius, starting at the end of the end-link tongue so the end link stays straight; end_y = bend_y + 2.2 R

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

lume.note: white lume strip as photographed in daylight (jamtangan.com lume shot: it glows on both hands and the index ends)

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material
